title: A hit and a miss
text: Signed up for 2 boxes for our St. Bernard and Bernese Mt. dogs. They looooove the toys (we got the 50lbs + boxes) two toys in each box that squeak, jingle or krinkle. The treats were a complete dud. They are not picky about anything they put in their mouths but neither wanted anything to do with the treats (and we had 5 different ones!) So I'll skip the box subscription and just get the toys for now. Clever idea and may try again later.
